claim: A synthetic 40-unit 429 storm (token-bucket rail, capacity 3, refill 0.5/s) degrades throughput (rate-limited waits happen) but produces ZERO lost work units: accounting sums to exactly 100% and every terminal record is typed completed or rate-limited.

Backoff is bounded: the always-429 run TERMINATES (terminated=true) with typed rate-limited records, attempts stay within RATE_LIMITED_MAX_RETRIES+1 and waits within RATE_LIMITED_BACKOFF_CAP_MS; the naive-drop counterfactual loses 9/10 units, proving zero-lost is load-bearing.
